decisions.because: Round 7 on 27d0ea0: a pack's scripts/json.py was imported by the recipient's owner gate and ran unsandboxed during inspect/view/export/replay; a later phase on another source was hidden behind an earlier failure; view accepted a refused observation claiming a native pass; names colliding on case-insensitive filesystems and records citing absent blobs were accepted.

statement: Received pack data never runs in the recipient's tools: the recipient's owner gate runs isolated, so the pack's files cannot shadow its imports. inspect reads every blob a record cites against its address; descriptor names that collide after case folding or Unicode normalisation are refused; every phase's source snapshot is compared before any phase is classified; a refused or source-mismatched observation carries no native verdict and any other exactly one, matching its report.
